verified_contracts: OS Terrain 50 is an Open Data lower-resolution digital terrain product
grid data consists of heighted points at regular 50m spacing
grid and contour data are supplied in 10km by 10km tiles identified from the south-west National Grid corner
ASCII and GML 3.2.1 are available for the grid
ASCII heights are supplied to the nearest 0.1m
the ASCII header declares 200 columns, 200 rows and a 50m cell size
each grid delivery includes the ASCII data, GML, projection file, auxiliary styling XML and per-tile metadata
per-tile metadata includes tile reference, spatial representation, CRS and flying-date information
GML identifiers are unique for a release but are regenerated when a whole tile is refreshed
the GML CRS is expressed as EPSG 27700
spot heights are algorithmically selected and rounded and therefore are not substitutes for candidate-cell raster sampling
the product is maintained through a multi-year flying programme
